g.text: Production Runtime Workstream - Complete Swimlane with LOC Traceability
before any image pipeline is entered.
Native text + born_digital PDF → Unify (fast path)
- Extract text + validate quality for born-digital detection
- born_digital_degraded: text layer present but extraction yields garbage
(~18% of born-digital PDFs per PDF Association 2025)
- born_digital: Digital PDFs with valid text layer
- born_digital_degraded: Corrupt text layer → falls back to image pipeline
- hybrid: Mix of scanned and digital pages (per-page routing)
- Ensemble heuristics (stroke density, connected components, edge density)
- Routes to TEXT_DETECTED or NO_TEXT path
- Docling layout integration (egret-xlarge accuracy, heron speed, 11 DocLayNet classes)
- Coarse page attributes (layout_type, has_tables, has_figures, has_dense_math, has_handwriting)
Caption, Footnote, Formula, List-Item, Page-Footer, Page-Header,
- 3 heads: orientation (4-class), skew (±10° reg), resolution quality (0-1 reg)
G2: Script (1 head: script_class; has_non_latin+has_rtl rule-derived)
G3: Orientation+Skew (2 heads: cls + reg; confidence implicit)
G5: Page Attrs (5 heads: capture_cls + shadow/warping/code/resolution_quality)
- Upload to GCS for Unify handoff
- All 44 files from FILE_INVENTORY accounted for ✅
